known_pitfall_claim: If two representatives of the same direct-limit class have indices n' ≥ n, then g_{n,n'}(x_n)=x_{n'}.
pitfall_counterexample: Take indices 0<1<2. Let X₀=X₁=Bool and X₂=Unit. Use identity maps, define g₀₁ constantly false, and let g₀₂ and g₁₂ be the unique maps to Unit. These maps are coherent. Set x₀=true and x₁=true. The representatives (true,0) and (true,1) are equivalent because at upper bound 2 both map to (). Yet 1≥0 and g₀₁(true)=false≠true=x₁.
